interface.name: lanternbox_capture_manager_v1
interface.description: Version 1 exists only in a fixed HDR session and never changes the color mode. Version 2 also supports prepared per-session intent when available. A capturer must negotiate on the SAME wl_display connection used for wlr-screencopy, before requesting frames. Version 1 supports only HDR10 dmabuf capture; no shm or mixed SDR/HDR capture is supported.

request.name: get_hdr10

description.summary: opt this connection into HDR10 for this output

request.description: Creates a contract. Wait for done and validate every field before making screencopy requests. The contract remains immutable for its lifetime; generation identifies color semantics, not output dimensions. Mode/size changes still invalidate pending screencopy frames in the usual way. Keep this object alive while capturing. Destroying the last contract for an output revokes permission for subsequent capture requests.

request.name: get_session
request.description: Preparation is a probe: it acquires no lease and does not change output color. requested_mode is 0 for SDR or 1 for HDR. An unavailable HDR request prepares SDR instead; invalid metadata fails explicitly. Keep the session on the same connection as its screencopy requests.

interface.name: lanternbox_capture_contract_v1
interface.description: Events are sent once, ending with done, or failed alone. The output is the wl_output supplied to get_hdr10. All fields must be validated before capturing. RGB is full range and BT.2020/ST2084; there is no YCbCr matrix implied by this RGB contract. Consumer YCbCr conversion must use BT.2020 non-constant luminance, with encoder range signaled separately.

event.name: format
event.description: Version 1: generation=1, fourcc=DRM_FORMAT_ABGR2101010 (0x30334241), primaries=9 and transfer_function=16 (H.273 codes), full_range=1. Packed little-endian pixel: R bits 0..9, G 10..19, B 20..29, A 30..31. Alpha is always 3. RGB code values span 0..1023, PQ normalized to 10000 cd/m2 independently of the virtual display peak.

event.name: luminance
event.description: reference_white and mastering_max are in cd/m2. mastering_min is in 0.0001 cd/m2. max_cll and max_fall are in cd/m2; zero means unknown, never substitute the virtual display peak for unknown content metadata.

event.name: mastering_primaries
event.description: CIE 1931 xy coordinates in units of 0.00002 (ST2086 units, multiply by 50000). Order is red, green, blue, white. Version 1 uses BT.2020 D65.

interface.name: lanternbox_capture_session_v2

description.summary: prepared capture intent and producer readiness

interface.description: The effective mode is immutable. A successful SDR preparation emits mode then prepared; HDR emits mode, format, luminance, mastering_primaries, then prepared. No HDR metadata is emitted for SDR. A failure emits failed and invalidates the object; only destroy is then permitted. Preparation never changes the output. Capture requires activate and ready on this same connection. Concurrent mixed-mode admission is unspecified: an implementation must not claim readiness for an unsatisfied intent.

entry.name: invalid_state
entry.summary: request is invalid in this state

request.name: destroy
request.description: Release its lease, if any. In automatic mode the output returns to SDR after the last HDR lease is released.

request.name: activate

description.summary: acquire capture lease and await producer present

request.description: Valid only after prepared. Requests receive ready in request order, unless a terminal failed cancels outstanding acknowledgements. Repeated activation is idempotent for lease ownership and must still acknowledge each request. ready follows a full producer present matching the effective mode and current color epoch; it is not merely an output configuration acknowledgement.

event.name: format
event.description: Identical color semantics and field units to the version 1 format event; generation is 1 and is not the ready epoch.

event.name: luminance
event.description: Identical fields and units to the version 1 luminance event.

event.name: mastering_primaries
event.description: Identical fields and units to the version 1 mastering_primaries event.

event.name: ready
event.description: Nonzero runtime color epoch; separate from metadata generation and output size/frame fence generation.

event.name: failed
event.description: Terminal failure, including malformed HDR metadata or admission/activation failure. No ready follows a failure.
